body:
## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p1` · `domain:ui` · `area:records`, into `pm:queue`. The grid's saves carry the row's concurrency token, as the record surfaces already do

Triage seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-13T02:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p1:** silent loss of another user's write. A stale grid edit answers 200 and overwrites with no signal. This matches its sibling objectstack-ai/objectui#11773 (p1, Studio drafts).
- **No server dependency.** `dataSource.update(…, { ifMatch })` is already published and used: `ObjectForm`, `ModalForm`, `DrawerForm` and `plugin-detail`'s `InlineEditSaveBar` pass it today. Unlike #11773, this card does not wait on 18.0.
- **Direction:**
  - `ObjectGrid`'s `defaultRowSave` and `defaultBatchSave` pass each row's version as `ifMatch`, read the same way the record surfaces read it.
  - After a save, the row takes the token of the record the server answered with.
  - A `409` reaches the same conflict handling the record surfaces use. ⛔ No grid-only dialog and ⛔ no silent retry.
  - In a batch, a conflicting row fails on its own, and the other rows' outcomes are reported as they are. ⛔ The grid does not roll back writes the server already accepted.
  - **Pins:**
    - a stale row save sends `If-Match` and surfaces the 409;
    - a fresh save succeeds and refreshes the token;
    - a batch with one stale row reports that row.
- Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (`domain:ui`); rationale: one concurrency contract on every record save path.

Claim: PM loop round 5. The direction is triage `6137175992`: the grid's saves carry each row's concurrency token as `ifMatch`, a `409` reaches the record surfaces' own conflict handling, a batch reports per row and never rolls back, and the card's three pins hold.
Session: `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`
Account: `zhuangjianguo` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12292-grid-save-if-match`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12292`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#1`
File surface: the grid's two default save paths, read on objectui `main` `fd4872f` at 2026-10-13T03:57Z. Stop on a breach and explain it in the report.
- **The saves:** `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`. `defaultRowSave` (`:5338`) calls `dataSource.update(objectName, id, changes)` with no options. `defaultBatchSave` (`:5355`) makes the same call once per row inside `Promise.all`. Neither passes `ifMatch`.
- **Read and reused, not forked:** `dataSource.update(…, { ifMatch })` (`@object-ui/types` `data.ts`; `ApiDataSource`, `data-objectstack`). The record surfaces' conflict handling lives in `@object-ui/plugin-form` `occSave.tsx` and in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `InlineEditSaveBar.tsx` / `ConcurrentUpdateDialog.tsx`.
- **Allowed if measurement needs it:** moving a shared helper to one home. If that would add a package dependency edge, stop and report it first.
- Co-located tests and a changeset.
- ⛔ No grid-only conflict dialog, no silent retry, no rollback of server-accepted rows, and no new prop, spec key, export or i18n key unless the report justifies it.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier — dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui: "no path-derived mandate"`
Clause-②: no
Clause-② reason:
- The grid starts sending a header the published `dataSource.update` options already declare, against the server's existing optimistic-concurrency contract.
- No published type, export or accepted input moves.
- The diff touches none of the three contract surfaces (a `yes` declaration, `packages/spec`, governed text), so CI plus the seat's own read decides. If the dev's diff publishes a new member, the PR says `yes` and an at-tier review follows.
Responsibility: `objectui's ObjectGrid (@object-ui/plugin-grid), whose default row and batch saves omit the row's version | the record surfaces (ObjectForm, ModalForm, DrawerForm, plugin-detail's InlineEditSaveBar) already pass ifMatch and handle 409 | every user editing a list inline while someone else writes the same record: the stale write lands with a 200 and no signal (reproduced twice on the card)`
Thread-read: 6137175992
Serial constraints cleared: read at 2026-10-13T03:57Z on objectui `main` `fd4872f`.
- No open PR touches `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `occSave.tsx`, `InlineEditSaveBar.tsx` or `ConcurrentUpdateDialog.tsx`. `ObjectGrid.tsx` last changed on `main` 2026-10-11 (`2381c07f`).
- This seat's in-flight objectui#12294 holds `plugin-detail`'s three record-block renderers and the element data-source seam, and shares no file. objectui#12286, claimed in the same wave, holds `plugin-form`'s `MasterDetailForm.tsx` and `fields`' `GridField.tsx`.
